questions.title: What does this verse mean?
questions.prompt: Explain the direct biblical meaning in plain language.

questions.title: What does it mean to me in my specific circumstances?
questions.prompt: Connect this scripture to your current decisions, trials, or environment.

questions.title: What is God telling me personally?
questions.prompt: Listen for the quiet, personal promptings of the Holy Spirit.

questions.title: What is the verse saying?
questions.prompt: List explicit statements and biblical truths asserted here.

questions.title: What is the verse not saying?
questions.prompt: Address false assumptions, human exaggerations, or common misreadings.

questions.title: How can I apply it to my life?
questions.prompt: Define a tangible practical action or behavioral change.

questions.title: Is there a command for me to obey?
questions.prompt: Identify direct instructions given to the believer.

questions.title: Is there a warning for me to heed?
questions.prompt: Identify dangers, spiritual pitfalls, or errors warned against.

questions.title: Is there an example to follow or avoid?
questions.prompt: Character attitudes or conduct modeled in the passage.

questions.title: Is there an allegory or parable to interpret?
questions.prompt: Spiritual metaphors, types, and prophetic pictures.

questions.title: Is there a promise to believe?
questions.prompt: Covenant promises to claim, noting any conditions attached.

questions.title: Is there anything for me to pray about?
questions.prompt: Turn the passage into concrete prayer petitions.

questions.title: Who can I share this with?
questions.prompt: People in your circle who need encouragement from this truth.

topicalDimensions.title: Why & Why Not
topicalDimensions.desc: Why pursue this quality, and what happens when absent?

topicalDimensions.title: How & How Not
topicalDimensions.desc: How is it practiced practically, and what counterfeits exist?

topicalDimensions.title: Where & Where Not
topicalDimensions.desc: In what areas of life is it tested and demonstrated?

topicalDimensions.title: When & When Not
topicalDimensions.desc: What is the right timing and season for its expression?

topicalDimensions.title: What & What Not
topicalDimensions.desc: What is the true definition versus what it is not?

topicalDimensions.title: Who & Who Not
topicalDimensions.desc: Toward whom should this virtue be exercised?

sevenSteps.title: Pray to Begin
sevenSteps.verse: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
sevenSteps.desc: Quiet your thoughts. Give thanks to God for His presence and ask the Holy Spirit to grant you spiritual illumination.

sevenSteps.title: Read the Passage
sevenSteps.desc: Read systematically through your chosen portion. Read without rushing to take in the full context of God's message.

sevenSteps.title: Meditate & Reflect
sevenSteps.verse: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
sevenSteps.desc: Reread key verses slowly. Click any word in the Scripture Box to view its original Greek/Hebrew definition and lexicon notes.

sevenSteps.title: Deeper Study
sevenSteps.desc: Examine the verse through the 13 analytical questions (Microscopic) or the 6 W's (Topical) to identify commands, promises, warnings, and applications.

sevenSteps.title: Use Study Tools
sevenSteps.desc: Consult Strong's Concordance, cross-references, and reliable biblical guides to rightly divide the word of truth.

sevenSteps.title: Write Down Revelations
sevenSteps.desc: Revelations written down are remembered and practiced. Record what God spoke to you in the Journal Studio on the right.

sevenSteps.title: Conclude in Prayer
sevenSteps.desc: Convert your written revelations into real prayer petitions. Pray over the commands to obey, claim the promises, and spend time listening in silence.

### 🙏 Opening Prayer
> "Lord, open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law (Ps 119:18). Speak to my heart today; grant me spiritual wisdom and revelation in Christ."
